bio_en: Hakob Tovmasian was one of the last survivors of the Vaspurakan haiduk generation of the late 19th century, a man of the people who chose to serve his homeland unselfishly. Arrested after an attempt on Terzibashian in Van, he spent over half a year in a Turkish prison, and in 1896 fought in the eight-day battles of Van-Aygestan under Avetisian. In 1903 he left Van for Salmast, the Derik monastery, Tabriz, Yerevan and Tiflis, and in 1907, with his comrades, formally entered the ARF. He died in Iran on 21 June 1957 in deep old age.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Quotes #30 and #73 ('Whatever I had, I gave to the people...') are attributed to 'Tovmasian Hakob'.
